## 3. Notable Enterprise Clients & Case Studies

1. **ISKCON** (Global Spiritual & Cultural Organization): Nationwide digital reach and awareness campaigns.
2. **Meena Bazaar** (Premier Ethnic & Bridal Fashion Retailer): E-commerce revenue acceleration and high-ROAS Meta/Google catalog ads.
3. **VLCC** (Global Wellness, Weight Management & Beauty Brand): Performance customer acquisition and clinic footfall campaigns.
4. **QHT Hair Clinic** (Premier Hair Restoration & Aesthetic Surgery Clinic): Patient lead generation and local search domination.
5. **Dr. Jamuna Pai SkinLab** (India's Leading Cosmetic Dermatology Clinic): Medical SEO, brand reputation, and consultation booking funnels.
6. **Invision Overseas** (Global Study Abroad & University Consultancy): International student recruitment and visa lead funnels.
7. **Global Opportunities** (Premier Overseas Education Advisors): High-intent study abroad prospective student generation.
8. **GotoUniversity** (Global University Admissions & Education Portal): Organic search authority and international student traffic.
9. **Planet Education** (International Education Placement Network): Regional admission drives and Google Ads conversion funnels.
10. **Continental Immigration** (Global Visa & Immigration Legal Experts): PR, work visa, and investor immigration lead generation.
11. **Kundali Expert** & **Astrocaller** (Astrology & Spiritual Consultation Leaders): App downloads, horoscope consultation calls, and paid ad funnels.
